audit_method: git show at frozen commit; registry archive read in memory; no install/build/runtime/real credentials
scope_note_zh: 覆盖全部内置渠道声明 route tuple/WS flags、全部鉴权管理入口和数据入口、四订阅生命周期与关键行为约束；静态清单不能替代真实全参数行为验证。unsupported 也是边界，不是待补的基线功能。

release_gate.required_rule: For every baseline_supported capability, require pi_status == verified AND independent live_verification receipt; preserved CPA/Bifrost does not mean Pi verified.

findings.antigravity_builtin: absent in published JS/types/provider and oauth catalog
findings.grok_oauth: present as xai device OAuth; api.x.ai/v1 endpoint differs from baseline cli-chat-proxy.grok.com
findings.images: built-in image registry only openrouter-images, not baseline Codex/Antigravity image routes
findings.count_tokens: no countTokens/count_tokens contract found in published JS/types
findings.standalone_codex_search: no /alpha/search endpoint found in published JS/types
findings.websocket: Codex supports WS but source automatically falls back to SSE; not same as baseline strict WS contract
